title: Gems: Vaal Orb, then Crystallised Corruption
summary: Corrupt a finished skill gem with a Vaal Orb, then use Crystallised Corruption for a second, different outcome. The best case is level 21 with 23% quality; the community figure is that about half of the second corruptions destroy the gem.

budget.why: A finished gem is put at risk on every attempt, on top of a Vaal Orb and a Crystallised Corruption.
budget.build_needs: None: corrupting happens in the stash.

claim.note: Our reading of the method against the budget scale; not measured.

build.why: No combat: the method is corrupting gems in the stash.

claim.note: Not rated: the build scale measures map content, and this method has none.

complexity.why: The complexity scale is written for map setups, not for corrupting gems.

claim.note: Not rated: no step of the scale describes a corruption gamble.

durability.why_it_works: Crystallised Corruption gives an already corrupted gem a second outcome or destroys it, so a 21/23 gem can only be made this way.
breaks_when: Crystallised Corruption or the gem corruption outcomes are changed
21/23 gems stop selling above the expected cost of the attempts

claim.note: Our reading of the cited mechanic. Whether it pays today is only what live prices show.

inputs.text: A skill gem with its level and quality already done: a corrupted gem's quality and sockets cannot be changed

claim.note: maxroll corruption outcomes (aer0, updated 2026-05-24): add quality and sockets before corrupting.
'Modifies a Corrupted Skill Gem unpredictably or destroys it.'

outputs.text: Vaal Orb: nothing, +1 or −1 level, +1 or −1 socket, or −7% to +3% quality

claim.note: maxroll lists the outcomes without chances.

outputs.text: Crystallised Corruption: a second outcome that is never the first one again, or the gem is destroyed

claim.note: poe2db confirms 'unpredictably or destroys it'; 'cannot choose the same one twice' is maxroll's wording.

outputs.text: Best case: level 21 with 23% quality, from +1 level on one corruption and +3% quality on the other

claim.note: Our reading of the listed outcomes on a level 20, 20% quality gem.

odds.text: About half of Crystallised Corruption uses destroy the gem; how the other outcomes split is not published.

claim.note: Community figure: maxroll (aer0, updated 2026-05-24) says '50/50 chance to destroy the gem'. Not a datamined number.

steps: Finish the gem first: level and quality, and sockets if it takes them.
Use a Vaal Orb. Stop if the outcome is a loss you do not want to risk further.
Use Crystallised Corruption only on a gem whose loss you can take: about half of the attempts destroy it.
A corrupted gem can still be levelled, and a +1 level outcome stays as it levels (maxroll).
Sell the result on the trade site.
risks: Crystallised Corruption destroys the gem about half the time (community figure).
Corrupted gems sell on the trade site, not the exchange, so no EV is shown: the calculator takes your own gem price.
